ModMetaData.description: Animalese-style pawn speech. Zoom in to hear individual voices; zoom out to fade them away. Voices vary by pawn identity, biological age, sex/gender value, head and body type. Hover or select a speaking pawn to emphasise it. Audio only: no speech bubbles.
